facts.fact: ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera addressed POTRAZ at its 10th AGM as the Data Protection Authority, directing it to strengthen compliance monitoring, investigate unlawful processing of personal information and improve public awareness.
ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera referred to POTRAZ as the Data Protection Authority and told it to strengthen compliance monitoring and investigate unlawful processing of personal information.

Minister Mavetera directed POTRAZ to set explicit Universal Service Fund targets for connectivity in schools, clinics, chiefs' courts, rural business centres and underserved communities, and to publish coverage, quality, affordability and uptake KPIs quarterly.
